name: bottom-navigation
title: Bottom Navigation
description: Mobile app style bottom bar. A pill glides to the selected item, its label rises in, and the bar can shrink to icons while content scrolls.

props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon: string; href?: string; badge?: number | string }[]
props.description: Destinations. icon is the d attribute of a 24x24 stroked SVG path. Items with href render as links, the rest as buttons.

props.name: value / v-model
props.description: Controlled selected item in React (with onValueChange) and Vue (v-model).

props.name: onValueChange / x-on:change
props.description: Fires when an item is picked. Blade dispatches a change DOM event with the value as detail.

props.name: shrinkOnScroll
props.description: Collapse to icons while the content around the bar (its parent element or the page) scrolls down, expand again on scroll up.

props.name: action / #action / x-slot:action
props.description: Icon for a round action button next to the bar. The button only renders when this is set.

props.name: onAction / @action / x-on:action
props.description: Fires when the action button is pressed.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the nav element.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the action button.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description: Hidden text read after an item with a badge. {count} is replaced by the badge.

a11y: The bar is a nav landmark named by navLabel, with a list of links or buttons in tab order.
The selected item has aria-current="page". Every label stays in the accessible name even while it is visually hidden.
Badges are hidden from screen readers and read through badgeLabel instead.
With reduced motion the pill and labels change without movement.

ai.whenToUse: Primary navigation between three to five top-level views on mobile layouts or app-like web views.
rules: Use three to five items with short one-word labels
Give every item a value and an icon path
Turn on shrinkOnScroll when the bar floats over scrolling content
Use the action button for the single most common task, such as New transfer

id.description: Bar bawah gaya aplikasi mobile. Pill meluncur ke item terpilih, labelnya muncul, dan bar bisa menciut jadi ikon saat konten discroll.

props.items: Daftar tujuan. icon adalah atribut d path SVG 24x24 bergaris. Item dengan href menjadi link, sisanya tombol.
props.value / v-model: Item terpilih yang dikendalikan di React (dengan onValueChange) dan Vue (v-model).
props.onValueChange / x-on:change: Dipicu saat item dipilih. Blade mengirim event DOM change dengan value sebagai detail.
props.shrinkOnScroll: Menciut jadi ikon saat konten di sekitar bar (elemen induk atau halaman) discroll turun, kembali saat scroll naik.
props.action / #action / x-slot:action: Ikon untuk tombol aksi bulat di samping bar. Tombol hanya muncul bila ini diisi.
props.badgeLabel: Teks tersembunyi yang dibacakan setelah item ber-badge. {count} diganti isi badge.

a11y: Bar adalah landmark nav bernama navLabel, berisi daftar link atau tombol sesuai urutan tab.
Item terpilih memakai aria-current="page". Setiap label tetap menjadi nama aksesibel walau sedang disembunyikan secara visual.
Badge disembunyikan dari screen reader dan dibacakan lewat badgeLabel.
Dengan reduced motion, pill dan label berganti tanpa gerakan.

ai.whenToUse: Navigasi utama antara tiga sampai lima tampilan utama di tata letak mobile atau web bergaya aplikasi.
rules: Pakai tiga sampai lima item dengan label pendek satu kata
Beri setiap item value dan path ikon
Nyalakan shrinkOnScroll bila bar melayang di atas konten yang discroll
Pakai tombol aksi untuk satu tugas paling sering, misalnya Transfer baru
